Google just deepened its bet on custom AI chips — striking a deal reportedly worth $12.2B in Marvell Technology. This isn't just about hardware. It's about who controls the AI infrastructure race. While Nvidia dominates the GPU game, Google is quietly building its own chip empire to power the next generation of AI.
